summary: Fractal web: cancelling a composer image upload aborts its transport, restores the draft without an error, and prevents a late upload result from becoming an attachment.

replay.detail: No stored state or replay change.

schema.detail: No protocol change. The existing client request signal reaches the existing blob upload request.

compatibility.detail: An optional internal upload AbortSignal preserves callers without cancellation. Existing image and text sends are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Cancellation restores the unsent draft and its removable images; a retry uses a new request signal.
